title: Application repository identity
responsibility: Identifies an application by its normalized upstream repository or local Git store and compares checkouts or a plain site directory.

inputs.name: repositoryIdentity.directory
inputs.description: Checkout directory to identify through Git metadata and upstream addresses.

inputs.name: sameSite.site
inputs.description: Hosted site directory whose repository or plain-directory identity defines ownership.

inputs.name: sameSite.directory
inputs.description: Candidate directory whose membership in the site should be checked.

outputs.name: repositoryIdentity
outputs.description: Cached SHA-256 identity from a normalized network remote or canonical local Git store, following local clone origins up to the hop limit; null for missing or ambiguous origins.

outputs.name: sameRepository
outputs.description: True only when both directories have the same non-null repository identity. Shared template history alone does not establish identity.

outputs.name: sameSite
outputs.description: True for another checkout of a known site repository, or the exact canonical directory of a site outside Git. Unknown-origin repositories do not fall back to path equality.
